name: lace-cardigan-bedroom-selfie
image_purpose: Bedroom outfit post and casual lifestyle moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic 9:16 bedroom mirror selfie with a soft white lace-cardigan summer outfit.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with light-brown hair in a neat low bun, soft face-framing strands, warm fair skin, minimal makeup, gold hoop earring, pearl choker, and gray smartphone. She wears an open white crochet lace cardigan over a fitted opaque white camisole and matching white high-waisted shorts, standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose while lightly holding the cardigan edge.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait 9:16 waist-up-to-thigh mirror selfie with the subject slightly right of frame. Include a lived-in beige bedroom, unmade bed with white pillows, piled clothes and blankets, simple headboard, accurate phone reflection, and natural asymmetry.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal natural window light with gentle highlights on lace and hair, warm fair skin tones, casual everyday summer-bedroom atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone mirror-selfie look, eye-level three-quarter angle, shallow background softness, realistic pores and crochet texture, subtle grain, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 9:16 bedroom mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with light-brown hair in a neat low bun and soft face-framing strands, warm fair skin, minimal makeup, a gold hoop earring, pearl choker, and gray smartphone. She wears an open white crochet lace cardigan over a fitted opaque white camisole and matching white high-waisted shorts, standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose while lightly holding the cardigan edge. Include a lived-in beige bedroom, unmade bed with white pillows, piled clothes and blankets, simple headboard, accurate phone reflection, soft natural window light, realistic lace and skin texture, and casual summer-bedroom mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent garment, exposed torso, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
